items.project_definition: A synchronization gate ensuring all blocking infrastructure is verified before parallel feature development commences.
The core shared infrastructure layer that provides essential serialization and I/O capabilities required by all subsequent features.
The primary functional objective a user must achieve within a specific feature set.
A unique sequential numeric identifier assigned to each entry for precise targeting during updates or removals.
The lightweight data-interchange format used for persistent storage in the home directory and for machine-readable output.
The minimum viable product consisting of the absolute essential capabilities to create and mark entries as finished.
The structural grouping of implementation units by user story to ensure independent testability.
The set of mandatory design and contract documents required before implementation begins.
The primary documentation file detailing usage instructions and storage behavior.
The initial phase involving package skeleton creation and tooling configuration.
The specific implementation unit responsible for providing user feedback when no entries are available to display.
The verification suite divided into unit and integration directories to ensure logic correctness.
The process of automatically assigning a timestamp to the creation field during entry instantiation.
The operation that purges all entries marked as finished from the persistent store.
The operation that retrieves and displays all stored entries in either human-readable or machine-parseable formats.
A high-priority constraint indicating that subsequent work is strictly blocked until the current phase is fully validated.
